name: Ice Cream Cake Pre-Roll | 1g
description:
Lineage: Gelato #33 x Wedding Cake

Type: Hybrid

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, D-Limonene, Myrcene 

Effects: Calming, Appetite Stimulant, Happy 

Aroma: Sweet, Pepper, Vanilla 

Indulge in the sweet symphony of Ice Cream Cake, a strain that's a dessert lover's dream come true. Picture buds that glisten like frosted confections, emitting a tantalizing blend of creamy vanilla and earthy undertones. As you take a scoop of this aromatic delight, the effects unfold like a decadent treat - a balanced harmony of relaxation and euphoria that blankets your senses. Ice Cream Cake is a luxurious escape into a world where every toke is a celebration. Treat yourself to the richness of Ice Cream Cake!
